scene.title: Feast of Ash
scene.description: A cursed court ruled by the Ashen King: poison in the cups, whispers behind tapestries, and a prisoner who knows the truth about the fire that claimed the capital.
scene.gm_directive: You are the Game Master of a grim courtly fantasy. Emphasize intrigue, poison, and etiquette: every word at the table may be a trap, every courtesy a test.

clocks.name: Poison in the Cups
clocks.description: The poisoner is closing in on the hero's cup
clocks.finisher: The hero drinks from the poisoned cup! An immediate resilience check, or grave poisoning.

clocks.name: The Court's Patience
clocks.description: The courtiers are losing patience with the stranger
clocks.finisher: The court openly declares the hero persona non grata: the guard escorts them out of the halls.

quests.title: Unmask the Poisoner
quests.description: Discover who is lacing the cups with ash poison and present proof to the chancellor.

objectives.text: Name the poisoner before the court

quests.title: Free the Prisoner
quests.description: Break the chronicler out of the vaults — they witnessed the night the capital burned.

npcs.name: Chancellor Morwen
npcs.position: By the throne, beside the Ashen King
notes: Knows more about the poison than they admit

npcs.name: Krix the Fool
npcs.personality: Chatty, nimble, hides a sharp mind behind grimaces
npcs.position: Weaving between tables with a tray
notes: Their bells jingle for no reason

npcs.name: Odd the Chronicler
npcs.personality: Broken but stubborn keeper of the truth
notes: Saw who set the capital ablaze

factions.name: House Ash
factions.description: The ruling dynasty of the ashen throne
factions.ideology: Dynastic supremacy maintained through subtle poison, debt, and court etiquette.

factions.name: The Veil Circle
factions.description: A secret society of poisoners and whisperers
factions.ideology: Infiltration and overthrow of the corrupt aristocracy from within.

abilities.name: Silver Tongue
abilities.description: One well-placed word turns the courtiers to your side.

abilities.name: Poisonsense
abilities.description: A nose trained by years of distrust toward cups.
abilities.effect: Senses poison in nearby food and drink

scene.world_context: The capital burned ten years ago, and the Ashen King rules from his blackened halls. The court is split: House Ash holds the throne while the Veil Circle poisons cups and whispers behind tapestries.
scene.narrator_style: Weighty ceremonial prose in the present tense

location_map.name: The Ashen Throne Hall
location_map.description: A blackened hall with an ashen throne and a long feasting table.

location_map.name: The Vaults Beneath
location_map.description: Dank cells below the hall where Chronicler Odd is held.

location_map.name: The Wine Cellar
location_map.description: Casks and bottles; here the cupbearer fills the cups for the feast.

inventory.name: Silver Cup
inventory.description: Tarnishes on contact with ash poison.

inventory.name: Antidote
inventory.description: A bitter tincture of the Veil Circle.

inventory.name: Stiletto
inventory.description: A slender blade for close work.

inventory.name: Ashen Cloak
inventory.description: Heavy cloth that turns glancing blows.

facts.value: The capital burned ten years ago under unclear circumstances
Someone is lacing the feast cups with ash poison

beats.text: Survey the feast and learn who serves whom
A public accusation and the feast's denouement

scene.opening_narration: Candelabra smoke over the long table. The Ashen King does not touch his cup, Chancellor Morwen smiles a fraction too evenly, and Krix the Fool has twice now drifted past your seat.
scene.first_message: Morwen: "A guest out of ash and road. Sit closer to the fire — tonight, at this table, we decide who lives."
